changelog: Chaperone is now an MCP server (/Chaperone/mcp, admin API keys): any AI model can list unrated items, read details and lyrics, and propose ratings with evidence that Chaperone verifies. Trusted clients apply directly; others queue for review in the settings page. Applied ratings are locked and logged.
description: Fills in missing parental ratings for music (Deezer), movies & shows (TMDb), and anime (MyAnimeList) so parental controls work across the whole library.
name: Chaperone
overview: Automatic parental ratings across music, movies, shows, and anime.
